safety.scope: Governance metadata only: never enter patient-identifiable information.
safety.local.title: Saved in this browser only.
safety.local.detail: Nothing is sent to a server: colleagues cannot see these records, there is no audit log, no access control, and clearing site data deletes them. For a shared workspace, deploy the server (see the deployment guide).
safety.artifact.title: Stored in this Claude artifact.
safety.artifact.detail: Records are kept in the artifact's database, not on a server your organization runs. Access control is only partly enforced and there are no version snapshots. For the audited, access-controlled workspace, deploy the server (see the deployment guide).
safety.server.detail: This workspace is for review records, not clinical data. If patient information is entered by mistake, a project owner can purge it from the history; report it as your organization's policy requires.
fatal.denied.title: You do not have access to this workspace
fatal.denied.detail: The governance server refused this sign-in. Your account may not be authorized for this deployment, or your session may have ended.
fatal.denied.hint: Signing out and back in may help. If it does not, ask whoever administers this deployment to grant your account access.
fatal.unreachable.title: Cannot reach the governance server
fatal.unreachable.detail: This workspace is stored on a server, and the app could not reach it. Nothing has been lost: your projects are on the server.
fatal.unreachable.hint: This is usually temporary. If it persists, the API or its database may be down; check with whoever administers this deployment.
dash.title: AI projects under review
dash.lede: Every AI solution your organization is evaluating or running, checked against the CHAI lifecycle. Projects out of compliance or needing an update rise to the top.
dash.addSamplesTitle: Add any sample projects not already in this workspace
dash.legacy: A review of {name} was saved in this browser before the shared workspace existed.
dash.newNamePlaceholder: Name of the AI solution, e.g. Sepsis early warning
dash.searchNames: Search by name, developer, or sponsor
dash.searchAll: Search every field: a name, a vendor, a phrase
dash.searchNote: Searching the current text of every project you can open, archived ones included. Earlier versions and the audit log are not searched.
dash.searchNoteServer: An administrator can search those with make subject-access.
dash.empty: No AI projects yet. Add the first solution your organization is evaluating, or load {count} sample projects, one per CHAI use case, to see how compliance flags work.
dash.noMatch: No projects match. Clear the search or choose another status.
dash.archiveTitle: Archive: keeps the record, removes it from the active portfolio
setup.title: Project setup
setup.lede: Everyone with access to this workspace sees and edits the same project. Changes save automatically.
setup.f.cadenceHint: Defaults to 6 months for high risk, otherwise 12
setup.f.reviewersHint: Names and roles, e.g. CMIO, data science, nursing informatics, compliance, patient representative
setup.f.scopeHint: Sites, units, and versions in scope
fw.title: Frameworks
fw.lede: CHAI always runs. Switching another framework on adds its questions alongside; answers are kept if you switch it off again, and neither framework changes the other's status.
fw.onDetail: its views appear in the rail below CHAI's
fw.offDetail: 77 adoption questions, answered by five stakeholders
access.you.owner: You are an owner of this project.
access.you.writer: You have write access to this project.
access.you.reader: You have read-only access to this project.
access.you.none: You are not listed on this project.
access.title: Access
access.unenforced.title: Roles are not enforced in this view.
access.unenforced.detail: This browser has no signed-in user, so there is nobody to check a permission against. Anyone who can open this page can change anything in it. Run the tool with a backend, or publish it as a shared artifact, for access control to mean anything.
access.open: No access list recorded, so this project is open to everyone in the workspace. Claim it to restrict who can change it.
access.sole.title: You are this project's only owner.
access.sole.detail: If your account is disabled, for instance when you leave, nobody will be able to open, export or reassign this record, and it becomes unreachable. Add a second owner below.
access.lede: Owners can delete, archive and change access. Writers can fill in the review. Readers can see it and change nothing.
log.title: Changelog
log.lede: Every change to this record, with who made it and when.
log.cap: This view shows at most 500 entries. The full history is available from the API: {api}
fp.title: Record fingerprint
fp.lede: A fingerprint of this record's contents right now. Quote it alongside an exported report to tie the report to the exact state it came from. Volatile fields, such as the last-saved timestamp, are excluded so the fingerprint only moves when something substantive does.
fp.warnDetail: MD5 has been collision-broken since 2004, and anyone who can edit the record can also recompute its fingerprint. It answers "is this the same version?" and must not be offered as evidence that a record was not altered. A SHA-256 travels in the JSON export for anyone who needs the stronger property.

metrics.title: Key metrics
metrics.lede: Report each metric with the population it was measured on. Add one row per subgroup for fairness results.
metrics.none: No metrics yet. Add the ones your team will stand behind.
te.choose: Choose a use case to see the methods and metrics CHAI's workgroups agreed on for it.
te.recommended: Recommended by CHAI for this use case
te.credit: {count} methods and metrics, reproduced under CC BY 4.0 from {link}, © 2025 Coalition for Health AI. Follow the link for each one's description, rationale, benchmark and supporting literature.
te.lede: CHAI's guidance is to review the use-case Testing & Evaluation framework when completing the model card. Selecting a metric adds its name and category; the value and population stay yours to measure.
